verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents an official Importer plugin that converts a Notion workspace to Markdown, including databases and formulas converted to Bases, and its import docs list Evernote among supported sources. Plain Markdown is its native storage format, and a community user reports migrating from Roam successfully. missing for 10: explicit documentation that internal links and attachments are preserved, documented Roam import support beyond an anecdote, and hands-on corroboration of import fidelity for Evernote or Notion.
